digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding and create dispatch
propositions: under dc's eventually-consistent lucene index, a crashed create leaves a keyless-pending binding unindexed, causing both recover_pending's search and create_one's dedup search to miss and unbind/create a duplicate issue

fixing recover_pending alone to retain pending entries is insufficient because get_jira_key returns none for keyless-pending entries, so the create gate in outbound_differ still fires and create_one still issues a duplicate

the create duplicate is prevented only by gating the create in dispatch_one.create_one to defer while a keyless-pending binding exists within an index-lag grace window, paired with recover_pending's corroborated unbind rule (3+ misses and age > grace period)

recover_pending must increment search_miss_count on negative searches and unbind only after both 3+ consecutive misses and the entry exceeds the grace period threshold, leaving genuinely-unindexed issues pending rather than immediately unbound
create_one must consult is_keyless_pending_within_grace to defer creates for young keyless-pending bindings, not only check get_jira_key(...) is none
recover_pending must not count still-pending entries as resolved in its return value to prevent the caller from treating the binding as settled
